description: Parses an HTML string into a reference AST for rebuilding the page in Webcake: title, description, og_image, language, and sections classified by role (header, hero, features, about, form, cta, gallery, testimonials, pricing, faq, footer, unknown), each with headings, paragraphs, images, CTAs, links, form fields and a size_hint (desktop section height in px — from CSS when explicit, else estimated). Also returns top colors, fonts, palette and background_images; for Tailwind-CDN pages (e.g. Google Stitch) the palette and `design_tokens` (spacing grid, corner radii, type scale) come from the page's tailwind.config. detail:'compact' (default, ~2–5 KB) or 'full' (up to ~25 KB: per-section blocks such as cards and steps, lists, gradients, images as { src, alt }, and `widgets` — the cleaned HTML + CSS of composite visuals such as device mockups). Fonts: `font_groups` lists self-hosted fonts from @font-face rules in the settings.fontGroups shape; `typography` and per-section `text_styles` give the computed font size (desktop and mobile), weight, family, line height and letter spacing. Absolute-canvas builder exports (LadiPage-family or Webcake-published HTML) are detected and converted deterministically into a complete Webcake page `source`, with `clone_notes` listing approximations and `canvas_summary` summarizing per-section geometry; external images in that source are re-hosted automatically when it is saved. Garbled Vietnamese text (UTF-8 read as Latin-1) is repaired, with a warning. No credentials, no writes.

base_url.description: The page's original URL, when the HTML was saved or copied from a live site. Resolves relative font and image URLs and fetches the page's external stylesheets (+ @imports), so self-hosted fonts (`font_groups`) and computed type (`typography` / `text_styles`) defined outside the HTML are included.

detail.description: Level of detail in the returned AST. 'compact' (default, ~2–5 KB): sections, top colors and fonts. 'full': adds the CSS custom-property palette (design tokens by name), background_images from stylesheets, gradients, per-section blocks (repeating card/tile/step structures with title/body/image/cta), li lists, extended paragraphs, images as { src, alt }, and per-section widgets = { hint, html, css? } — the cleaned source HTML + matching CSS of composite visuals (device mockup, chat thread, dashboard, browser frame). Both levels lift the design system from a `tailwind.config` block when present (Google Stitch / Tailwind-CDN pages): `palette` named by token (e.g. primary → #a43b38), `colors` ranked by usage, and `design_tokens` with the resolved spacing grid, corner radii and type scale (e.g. display-lg → 48px). Image URLs in the result (images, background_images, og_image) belong to the source page. Absolute-canvas builder exports return the deterministic `source` at either level.

html.description: Raw HTML of a page or a section.

intent.description: How the result will be used. 'adapt' (default): the reference provides layout and imagery while the text is rewritten for the user's brand. 'clone': text and images stay close to the original. Absolute-canvas exports return a clone `source` either way.

sections.description: Absolute-canvas mode only: return only these canvas section ids (from a previous result's canvas_summary.sections[].id; 'SECTION_POPUP' selects the popups). A full-page result marked canvas_summary.truncated:true has its styles pruned to fit the size cap; per-section results carry each section's `source` untrimmed, and `source.page[0]` is a single section node.

name: ingest_html
